categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Q&D Circuits Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs), focusing on mid-to-high-end prototype and small batch PCB products. Their product portfolio includes single/double-sided boards, multilayer boards, high-frequency boards, high-speed boards, HDI boards, thick copper boards, rigid-flex boards, semiconductor test boards, and millimeter-wave radar boards. The company serves diverse industries such as industrial control, communication equipment, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, medical health, and semiconductor testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including micro-blind and buried via techniques, laser drilling, fine line etching, resin plugging, and multi-lamination processes. They have proprietary and patented technologies in high-density interconnect (HDI) rigid-flex boards, high-layer count boards, low-loss materials for high-speed circuits, and millimeter-wave radar PCB production. Their production emphasizes flexible manufacturing to handle multi-variety, small-batch, high-quality, and rapid delivery orders, supported by computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) and just-in-time (JIT) production management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Q&D Circuits serves approximately 3,000 active customers, including over 100 publicly listed companies, mainly professional electronic product manufacturers, PCB traders, and PCB manufacturers. Their products are widely used in industrial control systems (e.g., machine tools, industrial robots), communication infrastructure (e.g., 5G base stations, optical modules), automotive electronics (e.g., ADAS, vehicle control systems), consumer electronics (e.g., PCs, smartphones), medical devices, and semiconductor testing equipment. The company maintains long-term stable relationships with key customers, many spanning nearly a decade.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production facilities in Shenzhen, Jiangxi, and Nantong. It has established overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong and the United States to support sales and customer service. The domestic market accounts for about 67% of revenue, while exports constitute around 28%, with sales mainly to electronic product manufacturers domestically and PCB traders and EMS providers internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Q&D Circuits operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on PCB manufacturing and assembly services. They procure raw materials such as copper-clad laminates, semi-cured sheets, copper foil, and copper balls from upstream suppliers and deliver customized PCB products to downstream electronic manufacturers and EMS providers. The company also utilizes outsourced processing for certain production steps to manage capacity and complexity.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment to maintain competitiveness in mid-to-high-end PCB products, focusing on emerging technologies such as 5G communications, optical modules, automotive radar, AR/VR applications, and AI server boards. In 2024, R&D projects included high-density HDI rigid-flex boards, PTFE resin plugging, low-loss micro base station filter boards, 4D imaging millimeter-wave radar PCBs, and PCIe 5.0 high-speed connector boards. They emphasize innovation in manufacturing processes, materials, and product performance to expand applications in industrial automation, new energy vehicles, semiconductors, and digital economy sectors.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized PCB products, including prototypes, small batch, and some large batch orders. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, with some customers adopting vendor-managed inventory (VMI) models. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance, with international sales recognized at shipment or delivery points depending on contract terms (FOB, FCA, DAP).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Q&D Circuits is positioned as a specialized mid-to-high-end PCB manufacturer focusing on prototype and small batch production, differentiating from large-scale mass production PCB companies. It ranks among the top 100 PCB companies in China and is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise. The company competes with domestic and international PCB manufacturers but holds a niche in flexible, rapid-response PCB solutions with advanced technology capabilities, especially in HDI and specialized PCBs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 793 million, a year-over-year increase of 11.19%, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 113 million, up 23.7%. Total assets grew by 75.18% to RMB 1.38 billion, and shareholders' equity more than doubled to RMB 1.08 billion. The company maintains a healthy growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity, increased R&D investment (about RMB 45 million in 2024), and a broadening customer base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Q&D Circuits emphasizes rapid response, flexible manufacturing, and high-quality PCB products tailored to customers' research, development, testing, and small batch production needs. Their ability to deliver multi-variety, small-batch, high-precision PCBs with fast turnaround times (single/double-sided boards within 24 hours, multilayer boards within 48 hours) differentiates them from traditional large-scale PCB manufacturers. The company’s strong technical capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and comprehensive quality management systems (ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO13485) ensure reliable, high-performance products that meet stringent industry requirements.
